title: Astronomy
tagline: What the light tells us, across forty powers of ten.
intro: Astronomy starts here with practice: three problem sets with worked solutions, from the parallax of the nearest star to the horizon of the observable universe. Almost everything we know about the sky comes from a few laws of physics applied with care, and these problems show how far a little gravity, light and counting can take you. Lessons will follow.

1.title: Problems with worked solutions
1.blurb: Orbits and the sky, light and the stars, planets, galaxies and the universe.
